'''Brian Avery''' (GEMP handle '''frodolight''')<ref name="t85495">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1436095#p1436095 Registered Players - 96], post by andytalaga1, 24 March 2025 (2025 Retro League player list of names and GEMP handles), forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013120710/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85495.html Internet Archive].</ref> hosted the [[2023 Beezer Bowl]] and won its in-person Retro tournament.<ref name="pc-beezer">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/inaugural-beezer-bowl-a-major-success/ Inaugural Beezer Bowl a Major Success], starwarsccg.org (9 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/inaugural-beezer-bowl-a-major-success.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref> Avery also played the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-08-u-s-national-championship-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2-2026/ 2026 U.S. National Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
